points.headline: Nvidia pauses chip shipments to Southeast Asia.
points.body: Nvidia told partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the US tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China. It comes amid a scandal over Jensen Huang's ties to a former Megaspeed executive accused, without proof so far, of spying for China, while Intel faced pressure to give Washington a 10% stake for its grants.

points.headline: The AI buildout strains networks, power and planning.
points.body: Network operators wait up to 18 months for optical gear, with prices up about 50% as datacenters compete for the same parts. AI's energy hunger is fuelling a natural-gas boom, and startups like Q.ANT try light-based chips to cut power use. The UK rejected a national consultation on AI datacenters despite a 39,000-signature petition.

points.headline: Physical AI heads for mass production.
points.body: XPeng is preparing to mass-produce its Iron humanoid, aiming for one robot every two and a half minutes. Lute raised $20 million to give robots touch, Ant Group's Robbyant open-sourced navigation models, and GXO plans more warehouse robots in 2027.

points.headline: AI reviewers start approving pull requests.
points.body: PyTorch's GreenLight lets an AI reviewer approve maintainers' pull requests, an open-source take on the system Meta uses to auto-land low-risk changes. At QCon San Francisco, Aviator's Ankit Jain said over 75% of PRs already merge without human review, as OpenAI, Anthropic and Sonar keep humans only on risky changes.

points.headline: AI misuse draws warnings and lawsuits.
points.body: Microsoft says hackers in China and North Korea use ARTEX, an agentic framework that automates attacks and can breach weak defenses in minutes. US states sued SpaceX, parent of X and xAI, to stop Grok generating child abuse and non-consensual images. Convex's coding-agent skills were caught sending users' app ideas to a remote server unannounced.

points.headline: Research makes models and agents cheaper to run.
points.body: Google's DeepCrossAttention matches model quality up to 3x faster by reworking transformer residual connections. Benchmarks find Code Mode beats tool calling past about 16 tools, 120x cheaper on large fan-outs, while speculative decoding speeds tool calls up to 1.7x but slows uncached agent loops.
